title: Base bias parameter
statement: For a real number $\varepsilon$ and a natural number $d$, define the base bias $\beta_d(\varepsilon)$ by $\beta_d(\varepsilon)=(\varepsilon/9)^{2^{d-1}}$, where the exponent is interpreted using natural subtraction in $d-1$.
